name: rush_hour_benchmark_200_19_21
description: A benchmark dataset of Rush Hour puzzle instances intended to evaluate planning, search and RL/solver algorithms on constrained-movement block-pushing puzzles. It provides multiple instances with varying difficulty and measures solvers' ability to find valid solutions efficiently. Useful for comparing success rate, solution length and computational cost across planners/agents.
evaluation_method: task_success_rate (percentage solved), average solution length, and time-to-solve
reputation: A niche benchmark hosted on Hugging Face used by a small community working on planning and RL research.
